name: 4-HO-EPT
summary: The 4-Hydroxy version of EPT. Slightly more potent than the prior.

pharmacology.text: 4-HO-EPT is a potent full agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2C receptors. It has one to two orders of magnitude greater potency as a serotonin 5-HT2A and 5-HT2B receptor agonist than as a serotonin 5-HT2C receptor agonist. The drug also shows affinity for other serotonin receptors, such as the serotonin 5-HT1A and 5-HT6 receptors. 4-HO-EPT produces the head-twitch response, a behavioral proxy of psychedelic effects, in rodents.
pharmacology.kind: Non-selective serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: It was encountered as a novel designer drug in Japan by 2021.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psilocin-like tryptamines, can cause nausea, yawning, dilated pupils, muscle tension, a faster heartbeat, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, they can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類、類似脫磷酸裸蓋菇素（psilocin）的色胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、打哈欠、瞳孔放大、肌肉緊繃、心跳加快、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类、类似脱磷酸裸盖菇素（psilocin）的色胺类药物，可能引起恶心、打哈欠、瞳孔放大、肌肉紧绷、心跳加快、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: Psilocin carries two identical methyl groups on its nitrogen. 4-HO-EPT carries two different chains there instead, one ethyl and one propyl, making it a lopsided cousin of the mushroom compound.
fact.zh: 脫磷酸裸蓋菇素（psilocin）的氮原子上接著兩個相同的甲基；4-HO-EPT則接了兩條不同的鏈，一條乙基、一條丙基，算是這種蘑菇成分一個「不對稱」的近親。
fact.zhHans: 脱磷酸裸盖菇素（psilocin）的氮原子上接着两个相同的甲基；4-HO-EPT则接了两条不同的链，一条乙基、一条丙基，算是这种蘑菇成分一个「不对称」的近亲。
